title: EHR Standardization to OMOP
description: An AI-based framework for mapping heterogeneous EHR schemas and clinical concepts to the OMOP Common Data Model and generating validated data-transformation procedures.

title: Clinical Dialogue Summarization
description: An LLM pipeline that converts doctor–patient dialogues into section-aware structured clinical notes, using QLoRA-fine-tuned 70B-scale models and retrieval-augmented generation.

title: ScienceRAG
description: A retrieval-augmented generation system that combines real-time scientific paper retrieval with LLM generation for question answering and fact checking, using query rewriting, knowledge graphs, and hybrid databases for multi-hop research queries.
